proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack is a passive damage rider on weapon attack rolls, not an activated feature. ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family. A new family analogous to MasteryMechanics.OnHitTriggerMechanics is needed for class features that are passive on-hit riders.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll

proposed_widenings.name: damage_on_hit ClassFeatureEffect variant
proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect is limited to grant_extra_action and heal_hp. Sneak Attack needs a damage-rider effect type with a scaling DiceAmount.
proposed_widenings.evidence: deal an extra 1d6 damage ... The extra damage increases as you gain Rogue levels

proposed_widenings.name: weapon_type variable DamageType
proposed_widenings.justification: DamageType is a closed 13-value enum. Sneak Attack's damage type inherits from the weapon, which is not representable as any fixed literal. A variant such as 'weapon_damage_type' or a tagged union that marks the type as derived from the weapon is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.

proposed_widenings.name: disjunctive precondition gate for on-hit triggers
proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack fires only if Advantage is held OR (ally within 5 ft AND no Disadvantage). No existing surface type models disjunctive/conjunctive preconditions on attack-roll riders. The mastery trigger vocabulary (weapon_hit / weapon_hit_melee_only) is unconditional.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have Advantage on the roll ... You don't need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

proposed_widenings.name: weapon_property filter (Finesse or Ranged)
proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack is restricted to Finesse or Ranged weapons. No existing trigger or attachment type models a weapon-property filter.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon

notes: Primary structural blocker: ClassFeatureMechanics has only 'activation' family; there is no 'on_hit_trigger' family for class features. Even if such a family were added, four additional widenings are needed: variable damage type (weapon's type), disjunctive precondition grammar, weapon-property filter, and a damage rider effect kind in ClassFeatureEffect. The once-per-turn usage limit already exists (MasteryUsageLimit) and the level-scaling shape (DiceAmount threshold_tiers with axis=class) is fully representable for the 1d6→10d6 progression.
